h3: That's the archive.Ask me about any of it.
p: Every project I've shipped or am still building, filed in one place. Each folder runs a working slice of the prototype, so open the ones that catch your eye.
A smart parking platform that lets people reserve parking, book EV charging and rent out private spots in real time. 85% of usability test participants completed a booking within two minutes.

Talk to a doctor from right here.
A self-service healthcare kiosk that enables accessible remote consultations and streamlined patient care.
An AI and AR powered app for inspecting vehicles. I'm designing it right now, and the case study lands soon.

A compact, mechanically collapsible personal helmet for bike-taxi passengers and everyday riders. It goes from rigid for the ride to small enough to carry once you park. Any collapsible design needs engineering validation and certification before road use.

h1: A collection of UI screens focused on intuitive, engaging experiences.
h2: Smarter parking, made simple. Find, reserve, and manage parking spots with ease.
Turn your empty parking into income.
A Look Inside an Enterprise SaaS Application
A smarter way to manage your work.
Find people. Start conversations. Make connections.
h3: List your unused parking space for the hours you’re away, while drivers find and reserve it when they need it.
Set up your profile, add your interests, and show what makes you, you.
Explore profiles based on shared interests, preferences, and location.
Like someone, get a match, and start a conversation that could lead somewhere.
Reimagining the Brand for Father’s Day
Keeping the Experience Premium and Fashion-Focused
p: Find open parking slots around you.
Reserve your EV or parking spot in just a few taps.
Create and manage parking spaces with ease.
Find, reserve, and manage parking effortlessly with real-time availability and easy bookings.
Rent out your spot during unused hours.
Choose when your space is available and let others book it.
Manage timesheets, expenses, absences, approvals, and more, all in one place. Simplify everyday tasks, keep everything organized, and help your team work more efficiently.
Manage timesheets with ease. Track hours, review submissions, and keep work records organized in one place.
Stay on top of absences and expenses. Submit requests, manage leave, and track expenses quickly and effortlessly.
Whether you're looking for a meaningful connection, meeting someone new, or simply exploring, the experience is designed to make discovering people feel effortless and engaging.

I transformed the brand’s regular fashion shopping experience into a dedicated Father’s Day campaign. The focus was to combine fashion, gifting, and emotional storytelling while keeping the shopping journey simple and familiar.

The blue checkered background gives the interface a distinctive Father’s Day identity with a classic and masculine feel. Repeating the pattern across different sections creates consistency while allowing the products and illustrations to remain the visual focus.

The hero section establishes the emotional side of the campaign through the father-and-son illustration and messaging. Below it, the product grid smoothly transitions into shopping, making categories like shirts, T-shirts, kurtas, trousers, and watches easy to explore.

The lower sections bring the focus back to the fashion brand through promotional cards, brand tiles, and a dedicated shirt showcase. Editorial typography, subtle gold accents, clean spacing, and structured product layouts maintain a premium look throughout the experience.
